findings.text: The company was incorporated on 24 September 2014 and has been active for 12.1 years.
There are 3 current officers, comprising 2 directors and 1 other officer.
Two individuals hold significant control, with one owning 50 to 75 percent of shares and the other owning 25 to 50 percent.
The confirmation statement is overdue, with the last one made up to 9 October 2025 and the next due on 23 October 2026.
Accounts are not overdue, with the last accounts made up to 31 March 2025 and the next due on 31 December 2026.
No charges are registered against the company.
No insolvency record is held for the company.
The two current directors have a combined total of 4 other appointments, consisting of 2 active and 2 dissolved companies.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments and resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 462 is active with no insolvency records, but its confirmation statement is overdue.
